primaryChecks.text: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
